instruction: Create a symbolic link on the Desktop named 'current_todo' that points to the 'todo_list_Jan_1' directory.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
